title: Light the Cosmos
desc: Light the Cosmos: a free Dasara connect-the-stars game for Navratri Day 4 by World of Wonders Studio. Maa Kushmanda smiled and the universe lit up: join the stars in order to draw a diya, a lotus, a kalash, a star and the sun. English, Hindi and Kannada.
aria: A dark sky full of stars. Tap the glowing stars in order, 1, 2, 3, to join them into a shape and light up the cosmos.
